title: Market-wide figures shared per underlying across all users; ours shared only within one user's feed (row 8 gap G-8-1)
reference_behaviour: Market-wide prices come from one cached answer per underlying with a version tag, served to every user alike (bundle-findings 6.1; users never see it).
ours: Shared computation is keyed by the feed owner and never crosses two users' feeds, because each user has their own Zerodha feed (ADR-053); REQ-050 AC-4 load tests stay deferred.
